description: Bind an animatable property to a scene object, creating the timeline track that keyframes go on. This is the first step of building an animation: add the interpolable, then pose the scene and call studio_timeline_set_keyframe at each time you want. Find the models with studio_timeline_list_models. A 'dynamic' model animates one target at a time — 'guideObjectPos', 'guideObjectRot' and 'guideObjectScale' are the ones that move a character's bones or IK targets — and needs 'target'; the others take none. Adding an interpolable that already exists returns the existing one rather than duplicating it, so the call is idempotent. Requires the Timeline plugin.

model.description: model id from studio_timeline_list_models, e.g. 'guideObjectPos' or 'lightColor'

owner.description: disambiguates a model id published by more than one plugin; omit for the built-in 'Timeline' ones

name.description: disambiguates a model id that covers several properties — 'charClothes' and 'juice' register one per slot. Use the exact label from studio_timeline_list_models, e.g. 'Bra State'. The error message lists the choices when it is needed.

target.description: what the property applies to, for a 'dynamic' model: 'root' for the object itself, or a bone or IK target name from studio_list_bones. Animating a bone writes the same change amount studio_set_character_bone does, so the character still needs the matching FK or IK mode on (studio_set_character_kinematics) for the motion to reach the mesh.

alias.description: a name of your own, shown in Timeline's list next to the default label

output.description: the interpolable, same shape as one entry of studio_timeline_get_state's 'interpolables'
